audience: marketing and sales teams that run webinars in Demio

useCases.title: See which webinars run next
useCases.text: List the active webinars with their next session, status and time, and the registration link.

useCases.title: Review every session of a webinar
useCases.text: Get one event with every session of its series, then read the status and time of one session.

useCases.title: Check who attended a session
useCases.text: List the participants of one session, filtered by status, such as attended, did not attend or left early.

useCases.title: Register a person for a webinar
useCases.text: Register one person for a webinar and get their personal join link. A repeat call can create a second registrant, so do not repeat it.
